description: Default options of the yamlprims specification revision 1.3: YAML 1.2.2 Core resolution (section 4), integers limited to i128::MIN..=u128::MAX, explicit core tags directing resolution, non-core tags retained with a raw string inner, duplicate keys rejected (section 5.2), strict flow indentation in every parsing pass (section 9), merge directives rejected, and multi-document entrypoints (section 5.5): every document present is returned, and an empty stream is zero documents. Error kinds are the specification's snake_case ErrorKind names. Revision 1.3 adds the UTF-8-only input surface (1.3/E-2), states that f32 rounds the binary64 value (1.3/E-3), and pins empty-scalar anchors and EOF keep-chomping values (1.3/E-1, E-4).
